task: HuC6280 Synth VGM reference transport and source Files
behavior: Imported VGM/VGZ original bytes are retained under unique /vgm paths and survive Cassette export/import and local recovery. Selecting, restoring or validating a song does not open audio or run Code.

A compact VGM selector above Waveform/Spectrum provides Play/Pause/Resume/Stop and consumed song position. Reference playback uses a separate existing HuC6280 core through the existing AudioContext, calibrated song bus, Master and final desktop/monitor output; authored sound is retained.

Timed Wave, Noise, hardware LFO, direct DAC and supported 0x90–0x95 DAC streams play once. Native PCM matches the shared VgmPlayer bit-for-bit, including exact-frame Pause/Resume with retained unconsumed buffers and offsets.

Code and VGM are exclusive. Play/Resume retires Code and hand keys; Run and workspace replacement stop VGM. Global Stop, disposal, pagehide, audio failure and desktop output changes retire song resources. Stale startup/ownership hooks cannot stop newer Code or restart old audio.

Zero-static-voice sources require playback validation before replacing the extraction library. Valid unknown-Wave-RAM or irregular-DAC sources can be stored for song playback; missing-bank or malformed sources keep the prior library and authored sound. Voiceful snapshot extraction keeps its existing supported subset.
Files capacity/copy failure is reported separately without losing extracted instruments. Direct analysis retains 64 MiB compressed/expanded bounds; Cassette keeps its 16 MiB whole-project bound.

Source validation accepts one normal 3579545 Hz HuC6280, VGM 1.61–1.72 and supported uncompressed DAC banks. Other chips, dual/variant clocks, extra headers, compressed/ROM banks, invalid stream ranges and active bank/stride changes are rejected before playback ownership.
Readable original frontend modules, matching unchanged WASM, source inputs, rebuild sources, types and licenses remain together in the standalone ZIP.

browsers.legacyExpectation: Only the former irregular-direct-DAC extraction failure expectation changed: it is a valid timed song with zero static snapshots. The test proves original preset, held owner and audible authored PCM are retained without autoplay. The malformed missing-bank rejection assertion remains unchanged.

ci: The HuC6280 workflow now runs the song checker on the extracted standalone ZIP, sequentially with the Code and legacy checks. GitHub Actions was not dispatched.
scope: No physical listening, commercial game assets, commit, push, tag, publication, Tauri import or public npm/native DSP change. Song CH Live view, paused selected-CH audition/Capture, CH On/Off, Seek and direct interaction during VGM remain tracked in the completion roadmap. In this slice keyboard audition uses the authored instrument while paused; changing/loading an instrument stops the reference song.
